purpose: Add deployed SCOOT/LMCache CacheBlend and speculative-decoding leaves that are hidden inside top-level vLLM compound configs, plus executable dependency metadata for official parameters.

parameter_overrides.name: model_impl
validation_evidence: vLLM 0.20.0 vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:1120 and 1172 explicitly dispatch model_impl=transformers to the Transformers backend even when a native model implementation exists. Native support does not make the explicit Transformers selector unreachable.

Local Qwen2-7B-Instruct execution validated both vllm and transformers implementations. Native BO trial_0044 on 2026-09-05 used model_impl=transformers and exited successfully. This is executable capability evidence only, not workload performance evidence.

parameter_overrides.name: cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
validation_evidence: vllm-0.20.0/vllm/config/parallel.py:328-340 defines value 1 as token-level KV placement and value block_size as block-level placement; 1 and 16 therefore produce distinct effective KV layouts when DCP is active.

parameter_overrides.name: data_parallel_backend
validation_evidence: vllm-0.20.0/vllm/config/parallel.py:818-823 resolves data_parallel_backend=ray to the Ray distributed executor, while mp retains multiprocessing; vllm/v1/engine/utils.py:1039-1049 constructs a Ray CoreEngineActorManager for the Ray branch. The pinned environment has the Ray package installed.

parameter_overrides.name: disable_nccl_for_dp_synchronization
validation_evidence: vllm-0.20.0/vllm/v1/worker/dp_utils.py:18-33 keeps DP synchronization on the GPU device group when false and switches it to the CPU group when true; lines 43-51 execute the all-reduce on that selected group, establishing distinct NCCL/Gloo hot-path behavior for DP>1.

parameter_overrides.name: kv_cache_dtype
conflicts_or_overrides: When the measured attention backend is FLASH_ATTN, explicit uncompressed float16 or bfloat16 KV storage must align with the effective model dtype because the kernel requires query and key tensors to share a dtype. This condition does not prohibit fp8_e4m3, which uses the quantized-KV conversion path.
validation_evidence: vllm-0.20.0/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flash_attn.py:797 passes query and cached key tensors to flash_attn_varlen_func; the 2026-08-30 trial_0001 runtime with GPTQ/half + bfloat16 KV failed at this call with `RuntimeError: query and key must have the same dtype` after successful engine and KV-cache initialization.
The same workload's completed 50-round run contains quality-feasible fp8_e4m3 Trials, so the observed uncompressed dtype-alignment dependency must not be generalized to quantized FP8 KV storage.

parameter_overrides.name: gpu_memory_utilization
validation_evidence: Source: vllm-0.20.0/vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py compile_or_warm_up_model captures CUDA graphs, warms kernels and then preallocates sampler/logit buffers at maximum shapes. Initial model loading success alone does not establish sufficient headroom for warmup or all candidate batch/topology settings.

User-approved operational policy (2026-09-10), for this single-node 2x RTX4090 Qwen2-7B tuning scenario: reserve at least 5% of total per-GPU memory outside the gpu_memory_utilization budget for warmup, graph capture, transient allocations and estimation error. Therefore derive upper <= 1 - 0.05 = 0.95. This 5% is an explicit experimental safety policy, not a vLLM universal requirement or an empirical OOM-free guarantee. Do not replace it with an arbitrary 2% margin.

Derive the lower bound separately from MODEL-ARTIFACT-GPU-MEMORY-FLOOR (currently 0.75). Weight/activation/KV reserves inside that budget must not be confused with the outside warmup headroom. Search continuously across the resulting interval, not only legacy search_domain sample values.

parameter_overrides.name: prefix_caching_hash_algo
validation_evidence: vLLM 0.20.0 vllm/utils/hashing.py:26-59 and 81-99 dispatch sha256 to pickle.dumps(protocol=HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)+SHA256, and sha256_cbor to cbor2.dumps(canonical=True)+SHA256. These are separate executable serialization/hash paths, not aliases.

Local runtime validation on 2026-09-05 in vllm-0.20.0/.venv: both dispatch branches executed on two representative parent/token-tuple/extra-key inputs and returned distinct 32-byte hashes. Evidence: /home/lfy/sembench/my_storage/screening_results/mcp_runs/knob_range_q1q10_balanced80k_20260905/hash_algorithm_validation.json
This validates distinct effective implementations only; workload-specific performance benefit remains for downstream measured screening.

parameter_overrides.name: long_prefill_token_threshold
validation_evidence: Source: vllm-0.20.0/vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py caps num_new_tokens only when 0 < long_prefill_token_threshold < num_new_tokens. Thresholds at or above the maximum first-prefill token count have identical first-prefill capping behavior. Model context capacity is a legality ceiling, not a workload-derived useful search ceiling.

For a fixed fully profiled workload, derive a workload-specific search upper bound from the maximum actual complete request prompt token count (including template/system/chat overhead where applicable). Use token features, never candidate row counts. If features already describe the complete tokenized input, do not add system/template tokens a second time. Do not inflate the bound to max_position_embeddings merely to retain legal but redundant values. Preserve all integers from 0 through the observed maximum; retain the special 0 reference and account for runtime normalization.

This is a workload-specific search restriction, not a proof of equivalence for every runtime path: resumed/preempted requests can include generated tokens; speculative or async paths can have extra pending tokens. State this limitation. Widen only with concrete workload/runtime evidence and an explicit rationale, rather than automatically using model capacity. If prompt coverage is incomplete or the feature excludes template overhead, report the missing evidence instead of asserting a measured hard bound.
Legacy search_domain powers-of-two entries are example candidates, not a restriction on arbitrary integer thresholds. Runtime legality must also respect effective max_model_len.

parameter_overrides.name: distributed_executor_backend
validation_evidence: vLLM 0.20.0 vllm/v1/executor/abstract.py:60-72 dispatches ray and mp to distinct RayDistributedExecutor and MultiprocExecutor classes. Both are documented concrete executor values; availability of Ray does not require choosing Ray.

The supplied qwen2_7b_2x4090_cacheblend scenario declares ray_package_available=true but contains no fixed distributed_executor_backend or Ray-only deployment constraint. Single-node multi-GPU execution also supports mp. This establishes separate available executor paths, not a measured steady-state advantage.

groups.name: CacheBlendConfig
groups.description: SCOOT experiment controls that materialize LMCache CacheBlend through vLLM's KVTransferConfig. The feature selector and bounded leaves are screened together; raw JSON and workload delimiters are represented so they can be explicitly rejected instead of silently omitted.

parameters.name: cacheblend_mode
parameters.description: SCOOT feature-family selector. 'on' synthesizes LMCacheConnectorV1 KVTransferConfig and enables blending, 'off' omits that connector, and 'auto' preserves workload-provided behavior. For BO, on/off are the distinct controlled engine branches; auto is an orchestration fallback rather than a third CacheBlend implementation.

parameters.name: cacheblend_allow_prefix_caching
parameters.description: Compatibility gate controlling whether vLLM automatic prefix caching may remain enabled in a CacheBlend-on trial. It creates the CacheBlend+prefix-cache coexistence branch; feasibility and quality are measured by the same BO trial rather than by a separate experiment category.

parameters.name: lmcache_chunk_size
parameters.description: LMCache token chunk size passed through LMCACHE_CHUNK_SIZE. It changes cache granularity, transfer/reuse work, memory behavior, and therefore steady-state latency and throughput when the LMCache CacheBlend branch is active.

parameters.name: cacheblend_blend_min_tokens
parameters.description: Value materialized as lmcache.blend_min_tokens. It controls the minimum reusable token span for blending and can trade reuse overhead, TTFT, throughput, and result quality when CacheBlend is active.

parameters.name: cacheblend_blend_check_layers
parameters.description: Zero-based transformer layer indices passed to LMCache blend_check_layers. At a check layer, installed LMCache 0.4.5 compares newly computed K against cached K (sum of squared differences per token), then retains the top-ranked tokens for subsequent recomputation. Legal indices depend on num_hidden_layers in the actual model config, not num_attention_heads. The installed process_qkv shrinks q/k/residual after a partial-recompute check but compares against full cached K at the next check. Consequently multiple check layers with first recompute ratio below 1 cause tensor-shape mismatch; use a SINGLE layer index for partial recomputation. Different per-layer ratios are not implemented. Full recomputation does not shrink tensors, but repeated checks add work without reducing recomputation. Choose useful single-layer indices from inspected model depth and source/workload evidence, retaining the measured reference. This is a list-valued CLI string: one index 1 is encoded as categorical string "1", not integer 1 or nested array.

parameters.name: cacheblend_blend_recompute_ratios
parameters.description: Token recomputation fraction passed to LMCache blend_recompute_ratios. Installed LMCache 0.4.5 process_qkv reads ONLY recomp_ratios[0]; additional list elements are ignored, and per-layer distinct ratios are not implemented. Use one scalar ratio encoded as a CLI string category. At a check layer it selects max(1, floor(token_count * ratio)) tokens with largest squared K difference. Meaningful fraction bounds are 0 <= ratio <= 1; ratio 0 still selects at least one token, while ratio 1 retains all tokens. Higher fractions increase recomputation work and can improve quality; they do not guarantee monotonic quality. Multiple check layers with partial ratios below 1 are incompatible with the current tensor shapes. The layer and ratio list lengths are NOT required to match by this implementation.

parameters.name: cacheblend_blend_special_str
parameters.description: Workload delimiter materialized as lmcache.blend_special_str. It must match prompt construction semantics; changing it is not an engine-efficiency search dimension.

parameters.name: kv_transfer_config_json
parameters.description: SCOOT raw JSON escape hatch forwarded to vLLM KVTransferConfig. It can express CacheBlend, but the JSON object itself is not a bounded BO dimension; cacheblend_mode and the structured child fields synthesize it.

groups.name: SpeculativeDecodingConfig
groups.description: Bounded SCOOT leaves that synthesize vLLM SpeculativeConfig. The raw speculative_config JSON remains an escape hatch, while BO searches the n-gram feature selector and its gated token-count leaf.

parameters.name: speculative_method
parameters.description: SCOOT feature selector used to synthesize speculative_config.method. The bounded current domain compares ordinary decoding ('none', represented by omitting speculative_config) with vLLM prompt-lookup n-gram speculative decoding ('ngram'), which requires no additional draft-model artifact.

parameters.name: num_speculative_tokens
parameters.description: Number of candidate tokens proposed per speculative step. SCOOT materializes it as speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens; it affects draft/verification work and is meaningful only when speculative_method is enabled. The current BO domain is the finite integer range 2 through 8.

groups.name: ChunkedPrefillConfig
groups.description: Explicit boolean alias of the vLLM chunked-prefill engine setting.

parameters.name: chunked_prefill
parameters.description: Boolean tuning knob for chunked prefill. true maps to vLLM enable_chunked_prefill=true; false maps to enable_chunked_prefill=false. This is the sole search coordinate for that engine setting. CacheBlend on requires false. When false, max_num_batched_tokens must cover max_model_len.
conflicts_or_overrides: Alias of enable_chunked_prefill: never tune both coordinates.
validation_evidence: Baseline BASELINE_TO_TRIAL_ARGUMENT and Range SCREENING_TO_BO_NAME map chunked_prefill to enable_chunked_prefill.
The pinned vLLM BooleanOptionalAction accepts both enable and no-enable flags.
